director.art_summary: Strong visual pacing and clean layouts overall. However, Scene 3 suffers from a headline-to-highlight mismatch that left 'system' awkwardly isolated instead of branding the proprietary T-T-P concept, and Scene 4 exceeded the 2-word highlight limit resulting in clunky orange badge wrapping.

issues: Scene 5 violates honesty guidelines by promising rating gain in a specific timeframe ('gain rating points in three months').
Scene 5 CTA ('Watch our free video. The link is in our bio.') relies on generic internet-marketer funnel language rather than calm, high-performance authority.
Scene 4 refers generically to 'three-phase classes' instead of naming our proprietary T-T-P System (Tripartite Training System).
